The '''Dalchon system''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Star system/Legends|system]] near [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]; it was located in the [[Dalchon sector/Legends|Dalchon sector]].

[[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] faked his own [[Death/Legends|death]] in this system,<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> with the destruction of his [[Praetor-class Star Battlecruiser/Legends|''Praetor''-class Star Battlecruiser]] [[Battalion (Praetor-class)|''Battalion'']] because of a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] attack led by Tallon's ally [[Quist (pirate)|Quist]].
